verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published or reproducible accuracy benchmarks. You can run your own trials before committing, though: the pricing page offers 10,000 free pages with no card required and all features included, and the quickstart sample scripts can process a directory of your own files. Missing for 10: published accuracy benchmarks of any kind, a reproducible benchmark methodology or datasets, first-party eval or scoring tooling for comparing parse output against ground truth, and independent corroboration of parse accuracy.
